newsitem.title: ITALY: Olivetti shares slip after steady opening.
newsitem.headline: Olivetti shares slip after steady opening.

text.p: Shares in Italian information technology group Olivetti slipped in moderately heavy trading volume after a steady opening with foreign investors seen selling, dealers said.

They added that there was good activity in the shares which continued to show fluctuations in prices greater than the rest of the market. But there were no immediate reasons for the share price fall, they added.

Financial daily Milano Finanza reported Taiwan group Acer was interested in buying Olivetti's PC company while Il Sole 24 Ore newspaper said the group was planning a board meeting on Friday at which it would give representation to one or two of the foreign institutions which control 70 percent of its share capital.
No-one was available at Olivetti to comment immediately on the two articles.
At 0955 GMT, Olivetti shares had fallen 3.33 percent to 461.5 lire in a slightly higher Milan stock market.
